title: Turning the Tables: Biased, Imbalanced, Dynamic Tabular Datasets for ML Evaluation
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It focused on fairness related to age, income, and employment status in a bank account fraud detection context.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the research.
